sloka: अद्य अक्षोभ्यम् अपि क्रुद्धः क्षोभयिष्यामि सागरम् ।वेलासु कृत मर्यादम् सहसा ऊर्मि समाकुलम् ॥६-२१-२३॥।।
transliteration: adya akṣobhyam api kruddhaḥ kṣobhayiṣyāmi sāgaram ।velāsu kṛta maryādam sahasā ūrmi samākulam ॥6-21-23॥।।

translations.english: "(The ocean) Having made me angry, now I will torment the ocean even though it is imperturbable and has its limits. I will torment the ocean with its thousands of waves and mighty demons by my arrows and make the ocean cross its boundary."
translations.hindi: जो समुद्र सदा तटों की सीमा फे भीतर बना रहता है और बड़ी-बड़ी लहरों से परिपूण और अत्तेश्य है उसे मैं आज ही खलबला दगा
